_comment: Recipe for WorkDir/pdk/pdk_convert.py -> characterize.json (do not edit characterize.json by hand). spec = everything characterize.json holds besides devices; families = how each PCell family becomes netlist models. Layer names ("@met1") are looked up in the PDK's .lyp. Format and procedure: .claude/knowledge/pdk_files.md.
_comment_implants: Implant / marker layers a family may merge over neighbours in a row (merge_layers = these, drawn by the model, in this order).

spec._comment: Hand-written input for characterize_pdk.py. Everything PDK-specific lives here; the script is generic. Netlist parameters (W, L, nf) are the device line values; 'map' turns them into PCell parameters. Output: pdk.json next to this file.
spec._comment_format: Generated by pdk_convert.py from convert.json. Compact tree (WorkDir/pdk/pdk_tree.py, .claude/knowledge/pdk_files.md): "@name" = value from @refs; a dict with @members is a family that expands to one entry per member, {var} = the member's value, @when = per-member conditions, key+ appends to a list.
spec._comment_merge_layers: Implant/marker layers the structure placer may fill as one rectangle over neighbouring devices of the same model in one row, never across rows (npc across rows breaks licon.13; 05_miller_ota draws nsdm per row by hand). nsdm 93/44, psdm 94/20, npc 95/20, lvtn 125/44, urpm 79/20.
spec._comment_fill: A ring fill (n-well) encloses the ring's tap_layer by the DRC-measured enclosure; it is never allowed to shrink inside the tap (DRC alone accepts an n+ tap outside the n-well). tap_band = tap width as a function of GRW.
spec._comment_pcell_patch: pdk.json is characterised with a patched PCell (2026-11-06, by hand in the container, root, backup .orig next to it): libs.tech/klayout/python/cells/via_generator.py:124 npc_enc 0.01 -> 0.02, so npc encloses every poly licon by 0.10 (licon.15; was 0.09). Re-apply after a new container, then re-run this characterisation.

drc._comment: Full old deck (licon.7/12/15, difftap.8-11, poly.9, capm.11). Not shipped: a copy of sky130A.lydrc with FEOL = true and source($input, $top_cell), made by hand in the container (2026-11-06, same as designs/klayout/pymacros/full_drc.py). Re-create after a new container.
The KLayout deck has only difftap.1-3: no n-well enclosure/spacing of diff and tap (difftap.8-11), no capm.11. magic's tech file has the full rule set.

spec._comment_drc_ignore: Rules evaluated over the whole layout, not per fixture, ignored in every scan: vpp.5a/b/c = max met3/met4/met5 density inside vpp, computed against the total vpp area of the GDS (sky130A.lydrc lines 406-408), so they fire with any other vpp fixture in the same file (2026-11-10).
spec._comment_structure_gap_range: Scan range of structure-to-structure gaps (um): above the largest spacing between structures, deep n-well (photodiode): dnwell.3 6.3, dnwell to nwell 4.5.
spec._comment_snap: snap_params: PCell parameter -> grid it is rounded to before drawing. The res_poly PCell draws len on 0.01 um (len 2.877 gives a 3.000 um body), FETs and the MIM cap on the 5 nm manufacturing grid.
spec._comment_netlist: netlist_copies: instance keywords that give the number of parallel copies, first one present wins (xschem writes both m= and mult=; the MIM cap uses MF=, the varactor VM=). terms are in PCell parameters (after map and snap_params to the grid).

@set._comment: p+ tap ring tied to VSS. sky130 has no p-well drawing layer, so nothing to fill. With con_lev=metal1 the PCell draws grw >= 0.23 whatever is asked, hence grw_nominal 0.23.
n+ tap ring tied to VDD; one n-well covers the ring and everything inside it.

spec._comment_pins: Pin shapes per device class (the PCells carry no pin labels); a device's own "pins" replaces its class's. Each group: merged shapes on `layer`, minus `minus` if given, optionally only those interacting / not interacting another layer, sorted along `order`; `count` shapes expected. Every rect edge is fitted linearly in `terms` over the device sweep, with k = shape index, first/last = 1 on the end shapes; centres must fit exactly. A size that is not linear (S/D strip length steps with the contact count, w - len in 0.07..0.42; width 0.29 instead of 0.23 on short strips) is stored as a lower bound over the sweep plus the dense bound_sweep (slopes fitted to all samples, constant lowered to the worst one) and <size>_min = smallest sample; size = max of both, so the pin rect lies inside the real metal. size_terms: own terms per size. Gate pad width grows with l: bound over a dense L sweep. MOS: sd = met1 S/D columns (k = 0..nf, none connected; even/odd columns are the two terminals, which one is source is the router's choice), gate = met1 gate pads, one per finger, not connected. res: n1/n2 met1 end pads (k = 0 bottom). cap: met4 top plate over capm, met4 bottom-plate strap. Groups named after a terminal are that terminal's pins (viewer / 012 detail); ring = the shape is a closed ring: the rect is its outer bbox, ring_w its narrowest band. centre_tol (um): centres may miss the linear fit by this much (diodes: the PCell rounds the off-grid w / l of the area-perim sweep, met1 centre off by up to 3 nm; viewer pins only, not routed). Terminal order from the PDK's extraction (magic sky130A.tech device lines, KLayout LVS deck): var c0 = gate (met1 pads on the poly ends), c1 = n-well taps (met1 strips), b = substrate (nothing drawn); diodes: first terminal n = the diffusion (met1), second p = the well tap ring (li1); photodiode d0 = P (outer p-tap ring, li1), d1 = N (the small n-tap in the centre). var / diodes / bjt / photodiode / vpp are placed but not routed inside the block.
spec._comment_pin_labels: Fixed cells (BJTs, VPP) without a pins group: a terminal's pin = the shape under its text label. Layers [drawing, pin, label] searched in this order (a terminal labelled on two layers takes the first); per label the pin-purpose shape under it, else the drawn one. Label = terminal name (any case) or its alias, else a label starting with the terminal name (npn s = SUBSTRATE, c = C). vpp: b = SUB, m3/m4/m5 = MET3/MET4/MET5.
spec._comment_routing_rules: In-block routing (lib/block_router), copied into pdk.json as is: SkyWater periphery rules m1.1/m1.2, m2.1/m2.2, m3.1/m3.2, m4.1/m4.2, m5.1/m5.2 (width/space; met4/met5 only for MIM cap pins), via.1a/via.4a/via.5a, m2.4/m2.5 (via1 cut and met1/met2 enclosure on two / the other two sides), via2.1a/via2.4/via2.5, m3.4. pin / label: the purpose layers export_gds writes block pins and net names on.
spec._comment_routing: sd_via: placed on every contact_layer (met1) column over over_layer (diff) of a MOS to measure gap.x_routed, the row gap at which neighbouring S/D contacts can take different wires up to met2 (vias_gen min via is 0.32 x 0.26, r90 puts the 0.26 side across the 0.23 column). tracks: met2 wires running along a row channel. channel_layer: row gaps are poly to poly.
spec._comment_policy: Layout choices, not DRC: poly-to-poly gap between matched rows is at least row_gap_poly_min and the channel tracks need, rounded up to row_gap_round (user 2026-11-04; 05_miller_ota had 0.42 at the DP gates and 1.54 in the bias mirror).
spec._comment_annotation: Non-mask layer for the slot names export_gds.py writes (235/4 prBoundary.boundary is ignored by DRC and LVS).
spec._comment_blockage: Layer for the outer-router blockage box of each routed block (lib/block_router routing.blockages), drawn by export_gds.py for viewing only. 250/0 is in no sky130 layer map, so DRC and LVS ignore it (metN.blockage 6x/10 is checked by the KLayout deck: m1.3ab, m2.3ab, m3.3ab).
spec._comment_drc_samples: Per class: the model (and netlist values) drawn wherever a class sample is needed (baseline, structure gaps); a model's own drc_sample replaces the netlist values for its own scans. One class per kind of outer layers (npn has deep n-well, pnp not; n/p diodes differ by n-well), since structure gaps are per class.

_comment_families: One entry per PCell family. pcells: KLayout PCells scanned; types: regex on the PCell type choice (file name without .gds for fixed cells); model: netlist model name (expression, default the type); require_model: skip types without a .subckt in the SPICE library; derive: member vars, Python expressions over the discovery facts (see pdk_convert.py docstring), None/False left out; body: the characterize.json family body ({var} = member value).

mos._comment: nfet / pfet PCells, every type. HV (L_min >= 0.5: 3.3 V / 5 V devices) get their own L sweep, DRC sample and pin bound sweeps from L_min.

res_poly._comment: Precision poly resistors, width fixed by the model name. The PCell draws its body len + 0.12 long and LVS measures L on that body (05_miller_ota PLACEMENT.md, section 3); L_min = netlist L of the PCell minimum len. series: model R = rcon + r_per_um * L (one end resistance). xhigh_po: res_xhigh_po__base.model.spice rcon = -46.62/w^2 + 331.73/w + 20.576, rbody = L * rsheet / w, rsheet 2000. high_po: res_high_po_<w>.model.spice rcon, rbody = L * rsheet. Implant urpm (xhigh) / rpm (high).

derive.rcon: round(-46.62 / w**2 + 331.73 / w + 20.576, 4) if 'xhigh' in tname else mparams['rcon']
derive.r_per_um: round(2000.0 / w, 4) if 'xhigh' in tname else mparams['rsheet']

res_wl._comment: Resistors sized by W and L from the netlist: isolated p-well, diffusion (netlist res_generic_nd/pd, __hv = the PCell's hvt) and metal (li1, met1..met5; ends = the metal minus its .res marker). Metal resistors are class rmetal, without guard ring: in a p_ring the clearance scan ran to its floor (-0.3 um, DRC does not flag a li1/met1 resistor merging into the ring's li1/met1 - a short) and the tight 2x2 broke psdm.1 (2026-11-10); rmetal is placed as a block, not chained or routed. No series model: built-in sheet-resistance models without an end resistance. Not res_generic_po: its PCell width steps with the contact rows and is not even monotonic in W (W 1.0 -> 1.58 um, W 1.32 -> 1.32 um, 2026-11-10), so no linear footprint exists.

derive.mlayer: '@' + [d for d in drawn if '.' not in d][0] if pcell == 'res_metal' else None
derive.marker: '@' + [d for d in drawn if d.endswith('.res')][0] if pcell == 'res_metal' else None

cap_mim._comment: MIM caps: PCell type model__cap_mim = cap_mim_m3_1 (capm between met3 and met4), model__cap_mim_m4 = cap_mim_m3_2 (capm2 between met4 and met5; pins on met5).

cap_var._comment: MOS varactors (netlist W, L per finger, VM copies). Own well and tap: no guard ring.

diode._comment: Junction diodes; the netlist gives area (um^2) and perim (um) only: the PCell w x l is the rectangle with that area and perimeter (a square when the perimeter is too short for the area). Own tap ring: no guard ring.

fixed._comment: Fixed-size cells (one GDS each, no W/L): BJTs, photodiode, VPP (MOM) caps. Footprint = the cell's bbox; only the copy count comes from the netlist. Placed as blocks, not routed inside. VPP GDS without a SPICE model (the pol1m1m2m3m4m5 set, _test, _o2subcell) cannot appear in a netlist: skipped. The photodiode has no SPICE model in this PDK but an xschem symbol (pins d0 d1): kept.
